intuition: Choosing plus or minus signs is equivalent to choosing a subset with a derived target sum.

brute_force.approach: Recursively assign either sign to every number and count assignments reaching the target.

optimal.approach: Convert to subset sum (total + target) / 2 and count subsets with a one-dimensional DP updated downward.

edge_cases: A target outside the absolute total or with incompatible parity has zero assignments.
A zero-valued element doubles every existing assignment count.
